sloka: अद्यैव तं गमिष्यामि देशं यत्रानुजो मम।नहि भ्रातऽन् समुत्सृज्य क्षणं जीवितुमुत्सहे ।। ६.६८.१९ ।।
transliteration: adyaiva taṁ gamiṣyāmi deśaṁ yatrānujo mama।nahi bhrāta'n samutsṛjya kṣaṇaṁ jīvitumutsahe ।। 6.68.19 ।।

translations.english: "This very day, this very minute I shall reach the region where my brother died, I have no interest in life."
